What free allowance does the cited page state? Quote the sentence with the amount, the unit and the period, and set free_tier.stated to it; set free_tier.unit to the unit the page uses; say `not stated` with the URL read when the page prints none.
An audit of the first attempt judged these claims unsupported by their sources; settle each one first:
- compute/tabstack $.limits[0].value: Paid part is supported: Starter is $10 per month, 100,000 credits included, 15 requests per minute. The first clause, that the free credits are a Trial with no overage that stops when they run out, is not on tabstack.ai/pricing (the page has no 'Trial' and no no-overage statement for the free credit
- compute/tabstack $.extras.free_tier_kind: The page says every new account includes 10,000 free credits and states no period, neither once nor per month (plan credits are labelled per month; the free credits are not). One-time-credit is an inference the page does not state; the lane's own c06 value says no renewal period is stated.
- compute/vertex-computer-use $.free_tier.metered_on: The cited page denominates the offer in USD of credit valid for 90 days and says nothing about what it is metered on. The pricing page (sha256:d570caa0) bills Computer Use in vCPU-hours and GiB-hours, which would make a time meter plausible, but that is a different source from the one cited.
